description: Implementation of a ConstantOperator class for generating constant values in a fuzzing framework, including methods for code generation and handling tensor and scalar specifications.

classes.name: ConstantOperator
classes.description: Operator class for generating constant values, supporting code generation for scalar and tensor specifications.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ConstantOperator instance, setting the operator name and default template.

methods.name: torch_op_name
methods.description: Property that indicates this operator does not correspond to a torch operation.

methods.name: set_template
methods.description: Sets the template used for context-aware code generation.

methods.name: can_produce
methods.description: Indicates that this operator can produce any output type.

methods.name: fuzz_inputs_specs
methods.description: Returns an empty list, as constant operator requires no inputs for fuzzing.

methods.name: codegen
methods.description: Generates code to create a constant tensor or scalar based on the output specification, using deterministic seeding for reproducibility.
